description: First full training run on Kaggle (lungnodule 0.4.0 notebook, QUICK_RUN = False)

model.weights: yolov5su.pt (Ultralytics YOLOv5s with an anchor-free head)

cpm_interval.method: percentile bootstrap over the 88 test scans (lungnodule.froc.bootstrap_cpm, seed 0)

verification: The candidates were re-scored offline with lungnodule.froc.compute_froc and with the Python 3 port of the official LUNA16 algorithm in tests/test_froc_official.py: all seven sensitivities are identical to the Kaggle run.

files.candidates.csv: The run's 6,311 candidates in the LUNA16 submission format
